## Selecting the right model

To implement a learning machine we must first formulate our problem and select a suitable model. This model can be a regressive model. There are also other models like polynomial degree

## Linear Regression

target variable is continuous (e.g. estimating financial aspects)

## Logistic Regression

target variable is binary (e.g. yes/no questions)

## Softmax Regression

target variable is a multiclass problem (e.g. image classification)
